quarterly_data.signal: New semiconductor inspection equipment supply contract with YILING TRADING signed 09-28-2026 for supply to China: KRW 53,074,160,000 (USD 39,330,000 converted at KRW 1,352.00/USD on the order date; export, so VAT excluded), 104.72% of 2025 consolidated revenue (KRW 50,777,866,585); term 09-28-2026 to 05-30-2027; no down payment, payment 70% before shipment and 30% after final approval. The company notes the amount and term may change by agreement with the customer.
